claims.sentence: Academic leave is available to students and postgraduate students enrolled in the University’s main professional educational programs
Conscription for military service or signing a contract for military service
Medical indications
Other exceptional cases, including natural disasters or family circumstances
The leave is granted for a single period not exceeding 12 calendar months
However, if the leave is due to military service or medical indications, the period may not exceed two years
You may be granted academic leave an unlimited number of times during your studies
To apply, you must submit a personal application to the University Director
The application must use the form specified in Appendix 1 to the Regulation
Medical indications:** A medical conclusion issued by a healthcare organization within the state or municipal health system

Military service:** A mobilization notice, order, or summons from the military commissariat containing the time and place of dispatch to the place of military service, and a copy of the contract for military service in the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, certified in the manner established by Russian legislation
Other cases:** Other documents confirming the grounds for the leave, if available
The University Director or an authorized official makes the decision on granting the leave
This decision must be made within 10 days from the day the University receives your application and attached documents
The granting of the leave is formalized by an order issued by the University Head no later than 5 working days from the day the decision to grant the leave is made
Your educational relations are suspended while you are on academic leave
You are released from obligations related to mastering the educational program and are not admitted to the educational process until the leave ends
If you study under a contract, tuition fees are not charged during the academic leave
The leave ends when the granted period expires
You may also end it early by submitting a personal application
If you return early, you are admitted to studies based on an order from the University Head
If the leave ends naturally, you are admitted to studies based on an order from the University Director or an authorized official

The evidence does not specify what happens to academic progress, grades, or credits earned during the leave. The evidence does not define what constitutes "other exceptional cases" or "family circumstances" beyond the general listing. The evidence does not specify the exact form of the application for early return, only that it is a personal application
